data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 was GBP 164.889m and the claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 5.6m (gross). The managing agent explicitly cites a cumulative GAAP loss of GBP 4.64m in respect of 2018 & prior years principally due to a strengthening of the Casualty UK account following an in-depth actuarial reassessment. Named prior events in 2020 (notably COVID-19 and several weather-related losses) are identified and quantified in the notes, but the predominant identified cause of the 2021 prior-year movement reported is actuarial reserve reassessment/strengthening in casualty.
raw_causal_phrases: strengthening the Casualty UK account following an in depth assessment of the reserves by the PMA actuarial function.
The 2021 pure year of account has developed favourably to date with a Gross Earned Loss Ratio at 46.7% and the Syndicate has benefited from a benign year with minimal large loss activity.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening and closing gross claims outstanding taken from the technical provisions reconciliation and balance sheet. Prior-year development (gross) calculated from the gross claims development triangle (diagonal comparison per Lloyd's guidance) because no single explicit gross 'movement in prior years provision' aggregate was provided. The triangle method produces a calculated gross PYD of +GBP 5.614m (strengthening). The managing agent narrative cites a GAAP adverse movement on 2018 & prior of GBP 4.64m (attributed to Casualty UK reserve strengthening) which is consistent in direction. RITC / Part VII activity in late 2020 is noted in the report (could distort some comparatives) but the triangle and notes used appear coherent. All monetary amounts are presented in millions (GBP).
